hard_rules: $0: nothing that costs money or needs a card (no paid APIs, ImageGen or fallbacks).
Secrets never in code, logs, tests, commits, issues, PRs or chat; the owner enters keys in the Mac app, the Keychain or `wrangler secret put`.
No account creation, no changes to macOS settings/TCC/Keychain trust or provider consoles — give the owner exact steps.
Dialogue evals and bulk model calls only 23:00–08:00 Europe/Berlin, budgeted (count retries); daytime: single requests. On 429 no retry loops.
Audio is never stored or logged; logs never contain utterance text or keys.
No pronunciation assessment in any form (no_pronunciation eval = 100 %).
Dependencies only from ADR-0001 (Mac) / ADR-0002 (web+engine) allow-lists.
Contracts first: shared Swift/TS behaviour changes packages/contracts and both implementations in one PR.
Repository text in English; the owner is addressed in Russian.
Swift/Mac/native and mixed-parity changes run on the owner's Mac (local session); TS/docs/mocks may run in the cloud.
Production deploys, remote D1 migrations, devices and live tests are owner-run checkpoints.
